limitations: These are three source-reported contour-area scalars. Numeric reporting precision is preserved; error bars and uncertainty are unspecified, not inferred from rounding.

January 1 explicitly identifies U2 to the north and Ulysses to the south. The February and April values follow the source-defined northern branch of a composite path that uses Ulysses before splitting and U2 afterward. Pre-split parent areas are not independent U2 observations.

The source analysis dates are not exact simultaneous sampling times, formation dates or lifetime endpoints. The nominal splitting date and approximately completed split remain separate from registry initial separation.
The source uses SSH anomaly, not a verified native-ADT datum or the OSW maximum-speed contour. A 10 cm numerical level is not equated to 0.1 m modern ADT.
SSH contour streamlines need not be material boundaries in unsteady flow. No closed geospatial footprint, state join, ranking, principal width, diameter, radius, thickness or seasonal range derived.
Three dated samples do not establish annual extrema, continuous shrinkage or an individual full lifetime. Nearby 150 m salinity measurements are not eddy thickness.
